scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc --project extension/tsconfig.json && tsc --project native-host/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: biome lint . && npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir extension
scripts.check: biome ci . && npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir extension && node --test
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir extension --firefox '/Applications/Firefox Developer Edition.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox'
